newsitem.title: USA: LTV plant fire causes $4-$5 mln in damage, outage.
newsitem.headline: LTV plant fire causes $4-$5 mln in damage, outage.

text.p: LTV Corp said Monday a fire at two steel pickel lines at its LTV Steel Cleveland Works on Sunday caused between four and five million dollars in damages and outage.

The damaged units, a 56-inch and an 80-inch pickle line, affect only about 10 percent of LTV Steel's total production and the company is confident that it will minimize the impact of the outage on its customers' schedules, it said.
It said that LTV Steel is assessing the extent of the damage and is reassigning production to other pickling units in the company, and, if necessary, would utilize outside resources.
It said the new "push-pull" pickle line at the facility was not affected.
It said the fire was discovered at the 56-inch pickle line at about 9:45 p.m. Sunday. The fire spread to the adjacent 80-inch unit before being put out by firefighters, it said.
It said the lines employ about 50 people and that no one was injured.
LTV Steel produces flat rolled and tubular steel products. It also supplies coated steel for the automotive, appliance, construction, container and service center industries.
